question: What is United Antipolo Specialists Hospital and Medical Center?
answer: We are a private specialists' hospital at 7 Marcos Highway, Barangay Mambugan, Antipolo City, Rizal. We opened in 2025.

question: Are you DOH-licensed?
answer: Yes. Our Licence to Operate number and service capability level to be published here in full.

question: Are you accredited with PhilHealth?
answer: Accreditation status and validity dates to be published here. Bring your CF1, CF2 and proof of contributions.

question: How many beds do you have, and what room types?
answer: Bed capacity, room types and current rates to be supplied.

question: How do I book a consultation?
answer:
Three ways:

  • Pick a doctor from our directory and book through NowServing
  • Call the trunkline 02 8248 3460
  • Message Viber 0947 875 4949

question: Which specialties do you have?
answer: Internal Medicine, Cardiology, Orthopedics, Pediatrics, Obstetrics-Gynaecology, and ENT – Head & Neck Surgery. Full specialty list and roster to be confirmed.

question: Do I need a referral to see a specialist?
answer: For most clinics you can book directly. Some HMO plans require a referral or a Letter of Authorization first — check with your HMO. Hospital referral policy to confirm.

question: Can I consult online?
answer: Yes, we offer telemedicine consultations. We also publish a video series called Doctor in the House.

question: What tests can you do on site?
answer: Laboratory, X-ray and imaging, CT scanning, and sleep studies through our Heart & Lung Unit — so you can usually consult, test and get results in one visit.

question: Do you have a CT scanner?
answer:
Yes. Our Radiology department is on the Ground Floor. CT aortography (aortogram) starts at ₱25,000.

Radiology: 02 8248 3460 local 111 · mobile and Viber 0962 245 3537

question: Do you do sleep studies?
answer:
Yes, through our Heart & Lung Unit — diagnostic, therapeutic (including CPAP titration), and split-night studies. Starts at ₱25,500.

Heart & Lung Unit: 02 8248 3464 · 0968 422 3538

question: Do you do gallbladder surgery?
answer:
Yes — laparoscopic cholecystectomy, which removes the gallbladder through small incisions instead of one large cut. Smaller scars and a shorter stay than open surgery.

Starts at ₱65,000, net of PhilHealth, including a private room for three days, operating room services, anaesthesia, supplies and medicines. Applies to non-emergency, uncomplicated cases.

question: Can I give birth there?
answer:
Yes. Our OB-Gyn team offers maternity packages, net of PhilHealth:

  • Normal delivery (NSD) — from ₱23,000 semi-private, ₱43,100 small private
  • Caesarean section — from ₱55,200 semi-private, ₱62,000 small private

Packages cover the professional fee, operating room, facilities, supplies and medicines. Newborn charges are separate. Non-emergency, uncomplicated cases; terms and conditions apply.

question: What if my HMO isn't on your list?
answer:
Call our billing desk on 02 8248 3460 and ask. New partners are added over time, and the list here shows the date it was published.

You can also ask your HMO directly whether UASHMC is in their network.

question: Which HMOs do you accept?
answer:
We are partnered with 20 HMOs, including MediCard, Intellicare, ValuCare, Pacific Cross, Kaiser International, Cocolife, EastWest Healthcare, MedAsia and WellCare. The full twenty are listed on our HMO page — if you cannot find yours there, call our billing desk and ask.

Being partnered doesn't mean every plan covers every service — that can differ by plan tier, your doctor and the specific procedure. Our billing desk confirms your case, and only your HMO can confirm what they will pay.

question: What is an LOA, and how long does it take?
answer: A Letter of Authorization is your HMO's written approval for a planned procedure. Processing time depends on your HMO — ask them directly, or call our billing desk and we'll help you follow up. Emergency care does not require one before you are seen.

question: Can I use PhilHealth and my HMO together?
answer: Usually yes — they cover different parts of your bill and need different documents. Bring your CF1, CF2, proof of contributions and a valid ID.

question: Do you give the senior citizen and PWD discount?
answer: Yes — by law you are entitled to a 20% discount and VAT exemption on medical and dental services, laboratory and diagnostic fees, and your doctor's professional fee. Present your OSCA or PWD ID at Billing.

question: How much will my treatment cost?
answer:
We publish starting prices for several packages — gallbladder surgery, CT aortogram, sleep study and maternity. Everything else depends on your room type, your doctor, the procedure and your coverage, and I would rather not give you a number that turns out to be wrong.

Our billing team will give you an accurate estimate. Call 02 8248 3460 or Viber 0947 875 4949.

question: What do I need to bring for admission?
answer:
• Your doctor's Admitting Order
  • One valid government photo ID
  • PhilHealth: CF1, CF2 and proof of contributions
  • HMO: your card and your LOA
  • Senior citizen or PWD ID, if eligible
  • Previous results and your current medicines list

Requirements vary by case and by HMO — our Admitting Office confirms your exact list.

question: What are your visiting hours?
answer: Visiting hours and the number of watchers allowed per patient to be confirmed.

question: How do I get a medical certificate or a copy of my records?
answer: Request them from Medical Records with a valid ID. Processing time, fees and whether a representative may collect to be confirmed.

question: Is your Emergency Room open 24 hours?
answer:
Our Emergency Room receives urgent and emergency cases, including on holidays. Exact hours and the ER's direct line to be confirmed.

If something is happening now, call 02 8248 3460 or come straight in.

question: Do I need a deposit before emergency treatment?
answer: No. Under Republic Act 10932, a hospital cannot demand a deposit or advance payment before giving basic emergency care.

question: Do you have an ambulance?
answer: Ambulance availability and how to request one to be confirmed.

question: How do I get to the hospital?
answer:
We are at 7 Marcos Highway, Barangay Mambugan, Antipolo City, Rizal, along Marcos Highway heading up toward Antipolo.

Jeepney and UV Express landmarks, and parking capacity, to be confirmed.

question: Is your online assistant a doctor?
answer:
No. It shares UASHMC information only. It cannot diagnose, assess how urgent something is, or tell you what medicine to take — only a doctor who can examine you can do that.

In an emergency, call 911 or go to the nearest Emergency Room.

question: What do you do with my information?
answer: We handle personal information under the Data Privacy Act of 2012. Chats with our assistant are logged so we can improve the answers. Privacy Notice and Data Privacy Officer to be published.

question: How do I give feedback or make a complaint?
answer: Email our customer relations team, or message Viber 0947 875 4949. Formal complaints process and response time to be confirmed.
